title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling samples, and docs quickstarts
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: onboarding users for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agents and tool-calling has been a frequent support ask; this PR adds opinionated templates, runnable examples, and docs quickstarts to reduce time-to-first-success. Summary: adds three RAG agent templates (faq-bot, docs-explorer, and multi-tool-assistant), two tool-calling examples (calendar and search microservices), updated docs quickstarts with step-by-step walkthroughs and screenshots, a small integration test harness, and CI doc-site deploy hooks. Checklist: * New examples included and smoke-tested locally * Docs quickstarts written and linted * Unit and integration tests for examples * CI site deploy updated to include new quickstarts * Added Linear links for tracking. Commits: - Add initial RAG templates and README for faq-bot - Add tool-calling examples: calendar and search services - Docs: quickstarts and screenshots for RAG agents and tool-calling - Tests: integration harness and CI flakiness fixes - Docs: minor wording nits and link fixes. Testing: unit tests for examples pass in CI (examples sandbox), ran integration smoke tests against local docker-compose stack, site build passes (hugo build). Rollout plan: merge to main will trigger docs site deploy and publish quickstarts; monitor support queue and community feedback for a week. Related tickets: ENG-4821, PM-1298. Notes: the templates are intentionally minimal and documented to encourage customization. If follow-ups are needed we will add additional language-specific SDK snippets in separate PRs.
